IGUI_WoodCutter_OutlineRangeHelp: Radius around the player in tiles when aiming with an axe held in both hands. Default: 5. 0 disables this mode.
IGUI_WoodCutter_WalkingRangeHelp: Radius outdoors on foot, even without an axe or aiming: 0–10 tiles. Default: 0 (off). Axe aiming uses its own range. Hidden indoors.
IGUI_WoodCutter_VehicleRangeHelp: Base outlines only, including passengers and stopped vehicles: 0–20 tiles. Default: 0 (off). Hidden indoors.
IGUI_WoodCutter_ToggleAmbient: Toggle outlines on foot / in vehicles
IGUI_WoodCutter_ToggleAmbientHelp: One key for both modes. Radius 0 stays disabled. Axe aiming is independent. Default: unbound.
IGUI_WoodCutter_AmbientEnabledHelp: Saved switch. The key changes the same state. Axe aiming stays independent; range 0 remains disabled.
